source.copy_policy: Byte-for-byte skill copy; no semantic changes.

external_runtime.target: macOS Codex App and Codex CLI
external_runtime.launch: scripts/launch.py uses os.execv with sys.executable and the deployed client path.
prerequisites: The independently deployed Mac LAN client and its private configuration are present.
Existing SSH authentication, verified host key, network route and Hindsight service are available.
The active project has an explicitly confirmed project_id to bank_id binding.
external_runtime.ownership: The MCP component owns SSH, configuration parsing and transport. Client fixes are deployed separately; the plugin does not copy that implementation.
